evidence: Static renderer/import-export inspection plus Review7 native polar/manual drag, save/reopen and original read for listed samples.

fields.controlPoints.0/1.x/y: Vectors relative to source/target topic centres
fields.controlPoints.0/1.angle: Radians rotating that vector about the matching outline endpoint
fields.lineEndPoints.0/1.x/y: Centre-relative reference directions for fixed source/target outline attachments
fields.flexibleControlPoints: Array of control vectors relative to source topic centre; separate from two ordinary controls
fields.boundary.range=master: Whole parent-topic branch including visible children, summaries, callouts and earlier master frames; native resizing disabled

checks: Native importer maps lineEndPoints to sourceRefPoint / targetRefPoint and exporter maps back
Polar controls use outline origins; they do not re-aim the outline attachment
When only one ordinary control exists, native missing control defaults to amount 0.33 and angle pi/6
Native insertBoundary creates master boundaries for selected detached and summary topics
Native flexible nonzero Cartesian vectors have a minimum length of 10; zero remains the source center
Native curved/angled virtual handles insert between existing controls; zigzag virtual handles move route segments
